title: eludite/test/update
description: Host-to-shell notification: the next piece of a discovery or run, in order (`seq` 0, 1, 2, ... per run). `kind` says which members are present: discovered (`container`, `tests`), results (`container`, `results`), output (`text`, `container` when it is one container's), launch (`container`, `launch`), attach (`container`, `processId`), containerFinished (`container`, `state`, `count`, `message`), finished (`state`, `summary`, `message`). A burst of tests or results is sent as one update (flushed every 16 ms). Every update carries the generation its discovery or run started under; the shell drops one whose generation is not current (CLAUDE.md invariant 12).

runId.description: The discovery's or run's id, unique within one host process, from 1 (discoveries and runs share one counter).

generation.description: The solution generation it runs under. A new generation (another solution opened, or this one closed) cancels it.

seq.description: 0 for the discovery's or run's first update, then consecutive.

container.description: A test container: one test project built for one target framework, named `<absolute project path>|<target framework>`.

tests.description: discovered: the tests found, in the runner's order.

id.description: The runner's id of the test, unique in its container: MTP's node `uid`, VSTest's TestCase `Id`. Stable across discoveries of the same build.

displayName.description: As the framework names it (a theory's data row includes its arguments: `AddsPairs(a: 1, b: 1, sum: 2)`).

fullyQualifiedName.description: `Namespace.Class.Method`, without a data row's arguments (MTP: `location.type` and `location.method`; VSTest: TestCase.ManagedType and ManagedMethod, else FullyQualifiedName).

namespace.description: The class's namespace (empty or omitted for the global namespace).

className.description: The class name without its namespace (a nested class keeps its `+` path).

source.description: Absolute path of the source file that declares the test, when the framework reports it.

line.description: 1-based line the framework reports for the test (xunit.v3: the line of the `[Fact]` attribute; VSTest's DIA lookup: the method's first sequence point, its opening brace).

traits.description: The test's traits (xunit `[Trait]`, MSTest `[TestCategory]` as Category, NUnit `[Category]`).

results.description: results: tests that started or ended, in the runner's order (a test may appear twice: running, then its outcome).

items.description: A test's state in a run.

id.description: The test's id (its discovered `id`). A test the runner reports that discovery did not list (a data row expanded at run time) has an id of its own and carries `displayName` and `fullyQualifiedName`.

container.description: Its container (eludite/test/status only; an update names its container once).

outcome.description: running: started (MTP `in-progress`, VSTest's active tests). passed, failed (MTP `failed`, `timed-out`, `error`; VSTest Failed), skipped (MTP `skipped`; VSTest Skipped), notRun (MTP `cancelled`; VSTest None or NotFound).

message.description: The failure message (MTP `error.message`, VSTest ErrorMessage), or the skip reason.

stackTrace.description: The failure's stack trace as the runtime printed it (MTP `error.stacktrace`, VSTest ErrorStackTrace).

output.description: What the test wrote: standard output, then standard error (MTP `standardOutput`, `standardError`; VSTest's StdOutMsgs, StdErrMsgs and AdditionalInfo messages).

text.description: output: the runners' log lines (MTP `client/log`, VSTest `TestSession.Message`, the host's own start lines), each ending with \n, for the Output window's Tests source.

launch.description: How to start the test application under a debug adapter (a debug run, `debug: true`).

program.description: MTP: the test application's DLL (CoreCLR, run by `dotnet` under netcoredbg) or .exe (.NET Framework, run by `mono` under eludite-dbg-mono off Windows). VSTest: the testhost's file name from vstest.console's TestExecution.CustomTestHostLaunch (`dotnet` for a CoreCLR testhost; then `args` starts with `exec`).

env.description: Variables to add to the inherited environment.

runtime.description: What runs `program`: dotnet (CoreCLR), mono (.NET Framework off Windows), netfx (the .exe on Windows).

processId.description: attach: the testhost process that waits for a debugger (VSTest's `TestExecution.EditorAttachDebugger2`). The shell attaches its adapter to it and answers with eludite/test/attached; the testhost runs the tests once it has the answer.

state.description: containerFinished and finished: completed (every requested test reported), failed (the runner could not start or crashed; `message` says why), canceled.

count.description: containerFinished: how many tests the container discovered or reported.

summary.description: Counts over every test the run covered.
